verdict.rationale: Mercury's own docs say Books is a double-entry system that generates P&L, balance sheet and cash-flow reports from current data. The statements are said to be ready on demand, with a choice of cash or accrual accounting and real-time reconciliation backing the numbers. But nothing documents choosing an arbitrary reporting period, and accuracy rests only on vendor claims. Mercury itself notes that bank-connected bookkeeping is not autopilot, though that is no concrete counter-example. Missing for 10: documented custom or any-period date-range selection, independent or hands-on corroboration of report accuracy.

support.subject: As a founder, I can generate an accurate P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statement for any period on demand
